title: cad_v3 frames: the SR2 hand as built (owner's CAD of 2026-11-04) on the UR5 CB3

sources.cad: assets/cad_v3/step (the owner's Onshape export of 2026-11-04, assets/cad_v2/full_cad)

frames.A: CAD assembly 'hand v3 (anthro config)': z_A up toward the robot, base plate z_A 0..3, flange face 28
frames.P: simulator palm frame = driver {P}: x_P thumb -> pair, y_P middle -> index, z_P up, origin on the yaw-centre plane midway between the travel-box centres
frames.E: tool0 of the UR5 CB3 (controller flange frame, URDF wrist_3_link): z_E out of the flange into the hand; M6 holes at 45 + 90 j deg from x_E, tool connector on -y_E

P.note: x_P = -y_A + t_x, y_P = x_A + t_y, z_P = z_A + t_z. t_y puts y_P = 0 midway between the index and middle box centres, t_x puts x_P = 0 midway between the thumb box centre and the index/middle box centres (the driver's convention, XY_space.png), t_z puts the yaw centres at z_P = 0. Primary t uses the thumb gantry moved +2.5 mm in y_A onto the base plate's holes; t_P_from_A_mm_cad_as_is uses the CAD as exported.

sensors.camera_note: Owner, 2026-11-04: the D435 is off the hand, on a tripod on the table; the d435_plate bracket arm stays on the hand. The optical frames below are the earlier assumed pose.
sensors.tag_face: confirmed by the owner, 2026-11-04: the tag faces opposite the thumb's palmar face (-x_P = +y_A)

camera_parts.label: Part 2
camera_parts.name: d435_plate
camera_parts.identified_by: the same solid as ~/Downloads/d435_plate.stl (owner's export, 2026-08-30 20:34) turned 180 deg about z: surface distance max 0.46 mm, mean 0.13 mm (match_downloads.py in this folder)
camera_parts.shape: 4 mm plate (z_A -4..0) under the base plate along its +x edge, from y_A 111 to 295.5; the last 52.6 mm overhang the base plate's +y edge (y_A 242.9)
camera_parts.screws: M4 clearance holes (d 4.4) at (6.5, 117.0), (-1.5, 173.8), (21.3, 230.4), on the base plate's holes; the robot mount has M4 nut pockets above the first two

fork.reading: a 20.4 x 20.4 mm pocket fits a 20 x 20 mm extrusion with 0.2 mm per side; the 5.4 mm hole fits M5 (2020 T-nut size) and lies on the slot's centreline. The owner's d435_mount_80-20.stl (same evening) takes a D435 on two holes 45 mm apart and has two rails about 21 mm apart (read from its render, mount8020_views.png) that straddle a 20 mm extrusion. Inferred, not measured on the hardware.

camera_parts.label: D435 body
camera_parts.name: Intel RealSense D435
camera_parts.note: not in the export: no solid of the six STEP files is 90 x 25 x 25 mm; the hand file has 33 B-rep part definitions and 127 instances (121 solids + 6 sub-assemblies) and no tessellated bodies

sensors.camera_mount_assumption: ASSUMED, not in the CAD: a vertical 20 x 20 mm extrusion standing in the fork's slot (centre x_A -4.0, y_A 281.3), the owner's d435_mount_80-20 (4 mm plate) on its -y face, the D435's back on the bracket by its two rear M3 holes, upright (1/4-20 down), lenses facing -y_A toward the hand, the bracket just below the tines: body centre (-4.0, 254.78, -33.3). Lower mounts move the frames along z_A only (variant tips_level: z_A -137.85).

tag.frame: apriltag convention: origin at the tag centre, x right, y down, z into the tag in the tag's own image; mounted with x up (+z_A), y = -x_A, z = -y_A, as the 2026-08-30 probe shows (tag x along image up) and tags.py assumes (--up-axis x)
tag.face: +y face (y_A 105.3), facing the thumb end and the assumed camera; the CAD does not mark which face has the tag
tag.printable_area: not modelled; the plate face is 45 x 50 mm, the printed sheet (gen_tags.py) has a 60 mm patch, and the 2026-08-30 probe shows it trimmed to about a 2.5 mm white border
tag.purpose: in the repo, id 6 was the static reference for an external D435 on a tripod (real_v1 bench, 2026-08-30/31): world up and a height datum, at 320-500 mm. On the cad_v3 hand it rides with the hand; under the assumed camera mount the hand's own D435 sees it face-on at 141 mm

tag_parts.name: static_tag_mount
tag_parts.identified_by: the same solid as ~/Downloads/static_tag_mount.stl (2026-08-30 20:34) turned +90 deg about z: surface distance max 0.35 mm, mean 0.09 mm
tag_parts.plate: 2.0 mm thick, x_A 0.1..45.1, y_A 103.3..105.3, z_A -57..-7: a 45.0 x 50.0 mm face on -y (2444 mm^2, flat up to the post) and 45.0 x 48.0 mm clear on +y (a 2 mm fillet and a gusset above z_A -9)
tag_parts.fastening: one screw at (6.5, 117.0) through its 3.4 mm hole and the d435_plate's tab; its post (x_A 11.2..14.2, up to z_A 18) lies 0.2 mm off the +x side faces of the base plate and the robot mount at x_A 11.0, which sets its yaw
